card.name: Salt endings of drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name that ends in a salt or chemical form, such as acetate, chloride, bromide, sodium or HCl. It fires in drug-label text just before words like injection, dosage or therapy.

modes.description: The ending piece of a drug name, such as -ate, -ide, -amide or -one, right after the stem.
